title: Warming Unevenly — DSC 106 Project 3
category: Interactive Data Visualization / Climate Data / D3
description: An interactive climate visualization showing which world regions heat up fastest under different CMIP6 scenarios, with linked ranking and trend charts, scenario controls, a year slider, and tooltips.
result: Uses CMIP6 near-surface air temperature anomalies against a 1995-2014 baseline, with the Arctic treated as a separate polar analysis region north of 66.5°N.
